evals.prompt: Plan a Facebook instant-form lead campaign with a Page, approved creative and a 120 USD/day budget. I need a proposal before we create anything.
required_behaviors: Selects Leads and validates instant-form destination, Page and form
Identifies budget owner, schedule and ad identity
Shows paused draft and separate approval for activation
forbidden_behaviors: Treats 120 USD/day as a hard daily spend cap

evals.prompt: Build a campaign for a regulated housing offer. The proposed age and geography limits appear under Advantage+ audience suggestions. Add Instagram Explore Feed and publish.
required_behaviors: Checks Special Ad Category, location eligibility and v26 audience field condition
Flags Explore Feed and prepares a revised proposal
